mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name FROM sys_dept WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY parent_id, sort, id
SELECT name FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code, name, spec FROM base_material WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, code, name, spec FROM base_material WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1
AND (code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT wo.id, wo.order_no AS orderNo, wo.material_id AS materialId, wo.finish_qty AS finishQty, wo.create_by AS createBy, wo.update_time AS updateTime FROM mrp_work_order wo WHERE wo.deleted = 0 AND wo.status IN ('FINISHED', 'CLOSED') AND wo.finish_qty > 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(wo.update_time, '%Y-%m') = #{period} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hr_piece_wage_detail pd WHERE pd.deleted = 0 AND pd.work_order_id = wo.id AND pd.period_id != #{periodId} ) ORDER BY wo.id
